placement: pick each tile by metadata.tileset_data.tiles[].corners (NW/NE/SW/SE = lower grass / upper dirt) and slice it by its bounding_box
notes: SANDBOX64 final (2026-10-23). The flat re-roll of the first T1 (cb3af596, raised slab). Flat: no ledge between grass and dirt.

params.upper_description: packed dirt path, muted warm brown, flat on the same level as the grass, calm low contrast, a few small pebbles
params.transition_description: grass thinning into trodden earth with a ragged edge, flat ground, no step or ledge
